newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Forint closes firmer vs dlr, yen futures popular.
newsitem.headline: Forint closes firmer vs dlr, yen futures popular.

text.p: Hungary's forint firmed towards the central bank's (NBH) resistance level in an almost tradeless Friday market, dealers said.
One forex selling order at the end of trade moved the forint to a closing level of 159.60. Until then the unit had been stuck within its opening range of 159.75 to 159.95.
The NBH's midday fix set the bid at 159.52.
Dealers said the significance of the shift was minimal in view of the tiny volume of trade.
"We shouldn't attach too much importance to the forint moving to the bid as it was virtually a tradeless environment,"
Butor said he expected the unit to move away from the bid again on Monday as demand for the Hungarian currency resumes ahead of end-of-year settlement deadlines.
Yen futures dominated heavy trade on the Budapest Commodity Exchange, accounting for almost half of total turnover of 9.73 billion forints.
